lines.text: David vows to sing of loving devotion and justice, and to walk with integrity of heart in his house.
David vows to walk with integrity of heart at the city gates.
David hates the work of those who fall away, and a perverse heart shall depart from him.
David will put slanderers to silence, and his eyes favor the mighty men of war, who may dwell with him.
No one who practices deceit shall dwell in David's house, and every morning he will remove the wicked of the land.
